"""ONE public, unauthenticated OKX websocket subscribe (public market data): one valid + one invalid instId. Records raw frames."""
import asyncio, json, time, sys
import websockets

URL = "wss://ws.okx.com:8443/ws/v5/public"
REQ = {"id": "qdlprobe1", "op": "subscribe",
       "args": [{"channel": "tickers", "instId": "BTC-USDT-SWAP"}, {"channel": "tickers", "instId": "RVN-USDT-SWAP"}]}

async def main():
    frames = []
    async with websockets.connect(URL, open_timeout=15, close_timeout=2) as ws:
        await ws.send(json.dumps(REQ))
        end = time.monotonic() + 6
        while time.monotonic() < end and len(frames) < 8:
            try:
                raw = await asyncio.wait_for(ws.recv(), timeout=max(0.1, end - time.monotonic()))
            except asyncio.TimeoutError:
                break
            frames.append({"received_at_ns": time.time_ns(), "raw": raw})
    print(json.dumps({"url": URL, "request": REQ, "frames": frames}, indent=1))

asyncio.run(main())
